title: Fan the flame
description: Focus on nurturing the next generation's faith by affirming their calling, encouraging boldness, and equipping them with the truth of Scripture. Challenge the current generation to fan the flame of faith in the next.

title: Pass it on
description: Highlight the importance of discipling others who will disciple others. Call the church to mentor, train, and empower the next generation to carry on the faith legacy.

title: Identity: Who am I?
description: A lot of young people are confused about their identity that affects the way they perceive themselves. Our true identity is found in who God says we are, not in our past, our failures, or even our own doubts.

title: Belonging: Where do I fit?
description: God invites us to a place of community a place to experience His love, mercy, grace, and protection. God brings people together in faith communities like churches to walk together, support each other, and experience love that goes beyond disposable relationships.

title: Becoming: Who do I follow?
description: God places people in our lives to help us grow into our God-given destiny. Young people need spiritual leaders who will guide and walk with them as they grow into their God-given destiny and purpose.

title: Purpose: How can I make a difference?
description: God redeems our past and calls us into a purposeful future for His glory. Purpose starts when someone trust the power of God into his life. No excuses can disqualifies us from God's purpose. When God calls us, our life becomes meaningful and he can use it as an instrument for His mission.

title: Holy Spirit as Helper
description: Our people will understand the role of Holy Spirit as our Helper that will be with us forever

title: Holy Spirit as Teacher
description: Our people will know Holy Spirit who will Teach and bring to remembrance the lessons taught by Christ

title: Holy Spirit as Witness
description: Our people will learn the role of Holy Spirit as the one who will bear witness about Christ.

title: Holy Spirit as Guide to all Truth
description: Our people will trust in Holy Spirit as the ultimate guide to all truth.
